bio:
Son of Jean Lamoreaux; captured at Fort Montgomery in Oct 1777.

FamilySearch gives John the dates 5 Mar 1754 to 7 Jan 1823 and his marriage to Jemima Stephens at Goshen on 9 Jun 1779, as in the Davenport genealogy. It attaches the 1790 census ('John Lomereaux, Junr') and the 1800 census ('John Lamoreux Junior'), so in 1790 there were separate households of John senior and John junior ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, John Lamoreux (KGC5-NN2), with attached index entries (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/KGC5-NN2
